visual.general_description: Two-panel figure of grayscale magnetic resonance images, panel A of the pelvis and panel B of the head, each with a coloured arrow and a red panel letter.
visual.detailed_description: Two grayscale images are side by side. Panel A, on the left, shows a pelvic image with several large dark rounded structures and a red arrow pointing to an oval structure with a dark wall and bright centre; a red letter "A" is above the arrow. Panel B, on the right, shows a slice through the head with both eyeballs visible at the top and a green arrow pointing to a small round dark-rimmed focus in the central posterior part; a red letter "B" is below and to the left of the orbit displayed on the left. Scanner overlay text at the image edges is partly illegible in both panels.

panels.general_description: Grayscale magnetic resonance image of the pelvis with a red arrow pointing to an oval structure.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale cross-sectional image of the pelvis with a bright background and several large dark rounded structures. A red arrow points to an oval structure in the middle of the image with a dark wall and a bright centre. A red letter "A" is overlaid above and to the left of the arrow. Small overlay text at the left edge and top is partly illegible and was not transcribed.
